options.what: A viral autumn trend on TikTok and Instagram where partners assemble cozy seasonal baskets packed with snacks, blankets, and fall comforts.
options.hamsterAngle: Ichigo proudly presents Teddy with a polished walnut shell stuffed with a fluffy moss tuft, one roasted pumpkin seed, and an acorn cap.

options.name: October 1st Girlfriend Tributes
options.what: An annual early-October trend where people post soft, cinematic tributes appreciating their girlfriends against cozy autumnal backdrops.
options.hamsterAngle: Ichigo poses dramatically bathed in golden late-afternoon window light, shooting pointed sideways glances at Teddy while he calmly cracks a sunflower seed.

options.name: The October Theory Reset
options.what: A viral lifestyle trend framing October as the true fresh start of the year for aggressive nesting, reorganization, and cozy home revamps.
options.hamsterAngle: Ichigo oversees a towering mountain of freshly gathered paper shreds and dried botanicals to rebrand their nest, while Teddy remains placidly rooted to his sofa spot.

options.name: Premature Sweater Weather Bundling
options.what: The relatable seasonal trope of diving into excessively cozy knit layers the moment temperatures drop even by one degree.
options.hamsterAngle: Ichigo is completely swallowed inside a repurposed woollen fingertip glove pulled up to her ears, while Teddy stares at the tiny knitted lump with quiet intrigue.

options.name: The Crisp Crunchy Leaf Hunt
options.what: A wholesome autumn trend focusing on the sensory joy and obsession of finding the absolute crispest dried fall leaves to step on.
options.hamsterAngle: Ichigo stands victorious atop a gigantic, perfectly crinkled dried maple leaf she dragged through the attic sill, daring Teddy to question its purpose.

bioIdea: Two tiny hamsters navigating big fall feelings in a cosy attic flat. Painted love and dry truths.
